_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We purchase, transport, store and distribute natural gas.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could adversely affect ONEOK Partners’ cash flow.' (the FY2007 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule)

classification.quality_note: 'We purchase, transport, store and distribute natural gas.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could adversely affect ONEOK Partners’ cash flow.' (the FY2007 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.02x; -7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.90; conservative 2yr +216%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.1%/yr (worst year FY02-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +49.2%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +49.2%/yr (FY02-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +49.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2008-12-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.02x (6.4% downside to Bear $26 / +281.7% upside to Bull $106) | Adj composite 3.00 vs market 1.10: gap +1.90 [UNDERVALUED] | -7% above the EPP floor $30 (10x FY08E $3.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +216.3% total (+108.2%/yr) | At 9.3x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $37 sits at or below the BASE case; net margin +33.8% and Distribution operating income -81.2% in Q3 2008, forward revenues +50.9% (no FY08 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2008 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a gas distributor and midstream company on this date; none has dated evidence.
